The workflow, at a glance

A simplified view of the workflow.

The problem

Running a one-person studio means carrying every handoff yourself. Ideas, scripts, recordings, edits, and derivatives need a repeatable path if publishing is going to fit alongside client work.

What I built

A seven-stage AI-assisted pipeline connects ideation and scripting in Claude, recording and editing in Descript, voiceover with ElevenLabs, and publishing and repurposing into short-form video, LinkedIn posts, and carousels.

The workflow includes automation and editing triggers, while recording and editorial judgment remain part of my work.

Why it matters

The resulting videos are also reusable teaching material for Clarity Works. The production system supports both public education and the work of helping clients build their own AI capability.

See it in use

The Clarity Works YouTube channel is the public output of this workflow. It is the clearest way to see both the educational approach and the content being produced.
